_comment: Fill every value a document needs before it can be seeded. seed-legal.mjs refuses to seed any document that still contains an unresolved [PLACEHOLDER]. Blank values are treated as unresolved. EFFECTIVE_DATE must be an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) - it also becomes legal_documents.effective_at.

PAYOUT TIMING: 7 working days after the experience has been delivered
